subject: Biology
title: Evolution
summary: Origin of life shayad lagbhag 4 billion saal pehle non-living organic molecules se hua (chemical evolution — Oparin aur Haldane; Miller ka experiment). Universe lagbhag 20 billion saal purana; Earth lagbhag 4.5 billion saal.

Evolution ke saboot: palaeontology (fossil), comparative anatomy (homologous aur analogous organs), embryo aur molecular similarities, aur dekha gaya natural selection (industrial melanism, antibiotic resistance).

Darwin ki theory: variation, overproduction, struggle for existence, natural selection (survival of the fittest — fitness matlab reproductive fitness). De Vries ne mutation (saltation) joda. Selection stabilising, directional ya disruptive ho sakta hai. Hardy–Weinberg principle aisi population batata hai jo evolve nahi ho rahi; gene flow, genetic drift, mutation aur recombination ise bigaadte hain.
Adaptive radiation (Darwin's finches, Australian marsupials) aur Dryopithecus se Homo sapiens tak human evolution chapter poora karte hain.

formulas.name: Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
formulas.formula: p + q = 1;  p² + 2pq + q² = 1  (p, q = allele frequencies; p² and q² homozygotes, 2pq heterozygotes)
formulas.when: Population evolve ho rahi hai ya nahi, test karna.

formulas.name: Factors disturbing H–W equilibrium
formulas.formula: gene migration (gene flow), genetic drift (founder effect), mutation, genetic recombination, natural selection

formulas.name: Types of natural selection
formulas.formula: stabilising (average favoured, peak gets taller);  directional (one extreme favoured, peak shifts);  disruptive (both extremes favoured, two peaks)

formulas.name: Miller's experiment (1953)
formulas.formula: CH₄ + NH₃ + H₂ + water vapour, electric discharge at 800 °C → amino acids

formulas.name: Homologous organs
formulas.formula: same structure/origin, different functions → divergent evolution;  forelimbs of whale, bat, cheetah, human;  heart and brain of vertebrates;  thorn of Bougainvillea and tendril of Cucurbita

formulas.name: Analogous organs
formulas.formula: different structure, same function → convergent evolution;  wings of butterfly and bird;  eyes of Octopus and mammals;  flippers of penguins and dolphins;  sweet potato (root) and potato (stem)

formulas.name: Industrial melanism
formulas.formula: England, peppered moth (Biston betularia): before industrialisation more white moths; after (soot-darkened trees, no lichens) more dark moths

formulas.name: Adaptive radiation
formulas.formula: Darwin's finches (Galapagos — different beaks for diet);  Australian marsupials radiating from one ancestor;  placental mammals parallel them (convergent evolution)
formulas.when: Ek area mein ek ancestor se kai forms.

formulas.name: Lamarck vs Darwin
formulas.formula: Lamarck: use and disuse of organs, inheritance of acquired characters (giraffe neck);  Darwin: branching descent and natural selection;  de Vries: mutations, saltation (single-step large mutation) in Oenothera

formulas.name: Geological timeline (plants)
formulas.formula: seaweeds and a few plants ~320 mya (mya = million years ago);  seed ferns → gymnosperms → angiosperms

formulas.name: Animal timeline
formulas.formula: jawless fish ~350 mya;  lobefins (coelacanth) → first amphibians;  fish-like reptiles (Ichthyosaurs) ~200 mya;  dinosaurs disappeared ~65 mya;  first mammals shrew-like

formulas.name: Human evolution
formulas.formula: Dryopithecus and Ramapithecus (~15 mya) → Australopithecines (~2 mya, East Africa) → Homo habilis (650–800 cc, no meat) → Homo erectus (~1.5 mya, 900 cc, ate meat) → Neanderthal man (1400 cc, buried dead, 1,00,000–40,000 years ago) → Homo sapiens (arose in Africa; ice age 75,000–10,000 years ago)

examples.title: Heterozygote frequency
examples.problem: Ek population mein recessive allele frequency q = 0.3. Heterozygotes ki frequency?

examples.title: Homologous ya analogous?
examples.problem: Bougainvillea ke thorns aur Cucurbita ke tendrils — homologous ya analogous?
examples.solution: Homologous: dono modified stems (axillary structures) hain, divergent evolution dikhate hain.

examples.title: Antibiotic resistance
examples.problem: Antibiotic resistance evolution ka example kaise hai?
examples.solution: Resistance dene wale mutations wale bacteria antibiotic treatment se bach kar badhte hain; kam samay mein population badal jaati hai — natural selection.

examples.title: Founder effect
examples.solution: Jab ek chhota group alag hokar nayi population basaata hai, to sanyog se uski allele frequencies bahut alag ho sakti hain (genetic drift); wahi drifted population founders ban jaati hai.

examples.title: Brain capacity
examples.problem: Brain capacity ke hisaab se lagaao: Homo erectus, Homo habilis, Neanderthal man.
examples.solution: Homo habilis (650–800 cc) < Homo erectus (~900 cc) < Neanderthal man (~1400 cc).

examples.title: Darwin wala fitness
examples.problem: Natural selection mein 'fitness' ka matlab kya?
examples.solution: Reproductive fitness — environment mein behtar fit log zyada santaan chhodte hain; iska matlab physical taakat nahi.

topics.title: Origin of life
topics.explain: Big Bang theory universe ki shuruaat samjhaati hai. Shuruaati Earth par atmosphere nahi tha; pighle hue mass se water vapour, methane, CO₂ aur ammonia nikle; UV rays ne paani toda. Earth banne ke lagbhag 500 million saal baad life aayi. Spontaneous generation ko Louis Pasteur ne galat saabit kiya; panspermia kehta hai spores outer space se aaye.

topics.title: Theory of special creation vs evolution
topics.explain: Special creation ke hisaab se saari species jaisi hain waise hi banayi gayi, Earth lagbhag 4000 saal purani hai aur diversity hamesha same rahi — fossils aur Earth ke lagbhag 4.5 billion saal purane hone ki studies ne ise chunauti di.

topics.title: Fossils and dating
topics.explain: Fossils chattanon mein life forms ke sakht hisson ke avshesh hain; alag umar ki rock layers alag life forms dikhati hain. Inki umar radioactive dating se nikaalte hain.

topics.title: Embryological evidence
topics.explain: Ernst Haeckel ne diya: saare vertebrate embryos mein sir ke peeche vestigial gill slits ki line hoti hai. Karl Ernst von Baer ne galat saabit kiya ki embryos doosre animals ke adult stages se guzarte hain.

topics.title: Mechanism of evolution
topics.explain: Variation mutation, gametogenesis mein recombination, aur gene flow ya genetic drift se aata hai. Natural selection is variation par kaam karta hai; peedhiyon mein nayi species ban sakti hain (speciation).

topics.title: Brief account of evolution
topics.explain: Lagbhag 2000 mya pehle cellular forms aaye; single cells multicellular bane; invertebrates bane aur 500 mya tak active ho gaye. Mazboot fins wali machhliyan zameen par aa sakti thi (coelacanth, 1938 South Africa). Amphibians se moti shell wale ande dene wale reptiles bane.
